title: Delp 2001: musculotendon length of spinalis at whole (mixed, cadaver)

source.authors: Delp SL, Suryanarayanan S, Murray WM, Uhlir J, Triolo RJ
source.sample: 5 cadavers (3 F, 2 M; 4 unembalmed, 1 embalmed); cadaveric specimens, mean age 67 (9.1) y (2 unknown), height 170.6 (4.2) cm, mass 76.2 (13.3) kg

how_to_simulate: Take the model spinalis element(s) named in the data (optimal fibre length / tendon slack length / MTU length in neutral posture).
Compare raw fascicle length with model fibre length in the specimen posture, and sarcomere-normalised length with model optimal fibre length.
protocol.notes: PCSA = muscle volume (mass/density) / optimal fascicle length. Table 3 compares with other studies' anatomical CSA (other authors; not stored).

extraction.check_notes: Table 2 rows single-line in text; re-read; abstract totals checked.
